artworks.title: Jason and Medea
artworks.description: Waterhouse paints Medea in Colchian gold beside the hero who won her with an oath — the witch-princess at the moment between eastern palace and western ship, when the Golden Fleece was already his and kin-murder still lay ahead.

artworks.title: The Argonauts
artworks.description: Dollman's frieze of the named heroes at the oar — Heracles, Orpheus, the Dioscuri, and Jason at the helm — visualizes the catalogue Apollonius and Hyginus roll for the first crewed voyage to Colchis.
